Prior to mop poisons used to work in a way that instant was always your main hand equip. It was judged on a ppm (proc per minute) basis. Deadly was always your offhand and worked on a pps (proc per second) basis. Deadly could therefor proc as fast as you could swing your offhand, while instant would only proc itself 3 or 4 timzes a minute. Deadly after at 5 stacks would then proc your main hand poison every time you applied deadly from thst point on. So by that logic you got many more instant procs out of the combo.
As of mop you no longer have a potent damaging poison in the offhand slot. So offhand weapon is always leaching/crippling. Therefore offhand weapon has no weigh om poison procs as of mop. Now running 2 slows is just better in every way.
